priority_actions.title: Escalate planning attention
priority_actions.action: Use the assessment as an input to preparedness and continuity planning, while checking official meteorological and disaster-management information for current conditions and instructions.
priority_actions.reason: The prototype cyclone scenario risk indicator is 87/100.

priority_actions.title: Review healthcare continuity
priority_actions.action: Review emergency access, backup power, staffing continuity and essential-service plans for mapped healthcare facilities within the assessment area.
priority_actions.reason: 494 mapped hospitals were identified within the infrastructure search area.

priority_actions.title: Review power continuity
priority_actions.action: Review backup-power arrangements, access plans and continuity procedures for mapped power substations.
priority_actions.reason: 31 mapped power substations were identified in the assessment area.

priority_actions.title: Review critical road access
priority_actions.action: Identify important road corridors that may need access monitoring and contingency planning during severe weather conditions.

priority_actions.title: Review school continuity
priority_actions.action: Review continuity procedures for mapped schools, including communication, access and temporary closure arrangements if conditions deteriorate.
priority_actions.reason: 488 mapped schools were identified within the search area.

priority_actions.title: Review low-elevation exposure
priority_actions.action: Review local drainage, water accumulation and access-continuity considerations for low-elevation areas.
priority_actions.reason: Earth Engine elevation at the assessment point is approximately 10.0 m.

priority_actions.title: Review dense built-area exposure
priority_actions.action: Prioritize situational monitoring and continuity planning in highly built-up areas.
priority_actions.reason: Dynamic World reports approximately 72.0% built probability at the assessment point.

priority_actions.title: Review highest-impact mapped assets
priority_actions.action: Use the infrastructure impact list to identify mapped assets that warrant closer local verification and continuity planning.
priority_actions.reason: Highest-impact mapped assets include: Sugumar Hospital, Meta Hospital, Naz Unani Hospital, Apollo Hospital, An-Noor Eye Hospital.

OpenStreetMap infrastructure represents mapped assets and is not a complete infrastructure inventory.
The prototype impact score does not establish the structural condition of an individual asset.
Rainfall duration and local drainage conditions are not fully represented by the supplied scenario.
decision_support.official_sources_note: CycloneShield AI provides prototype impact-assessment and planning information. Official weather warnings, evacuation instructions and emergency directions should be obtained from the relevant meteorological and disaster-management authorities.

It is intended for planning support and is not an official emergency command system.

Confirm shelter capacity and accessibility with local authorities before issuing evacuation orders.

Validate road status and alternate routes.
Issue or coordinate official instructions through authorized channels.
